title: LMS Dashboard
description: A responsive Learning Management System built using React.js and modern frontend technologies. Includes student and course management system, authentication (Login/Signup), CRUD operations, API integration using Axios, search, filter, pagination, and responsive UI with reusable components.

title: Notes App
description: A modern React.js Notes Management Application built with Context API for efficient state management. It allows users to create, update, delete, and organize notes based on priority levels for better productivity. The app also includes real-time search functionality for quick filtering and a fully responsive UI for seamless experience across all devices.

title: Digital Responsive Website
description: A responsive personal portfolio website built using React.js and Tailwind CSS, featuring a modern UI design and reusable components. The website includes a theme toggle (light/dark mode) for better user experience and a functional contact form with form submission handling. It is fully responsive, ensuring smooth performance across all devices and screen sizes.

title: Education Portal - WordPress
description: A live education portal built using WordPress with SEO optimization and automation features including 100+ subdomain management, WPForms integration, Yoast SEO, CRM integration, and WhatsApp automation.

title: Google Ads Landing Pages
description: High-conversion landing pages built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Focused on mobile-first design, fast loading performance, lead capture forms, CRM integration, and WhatsApp automation.
